verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a payroll/HR SaaS with a REST API, but the evidence shows no bulk or batch endpoints and no bulk-edit UI. The API docs mention only paging, rate limiting, workers and webhooks; paging is read pagination, not bulk writes. Marketing claims about one-click payroll for the whole team describe the core payroll run, not a general ability to act on many items at once.
